title: Markets React to Inflation Data and Nvidia Latest

segments: Inflation data and Fed rate outlook
Trump trade tariffs and economic impact
Gary Hufbauer tribute and trade history
summary.headline: Fed's preferred inflation gauge hits 3.3%; economists debate tariff impacts
summary.tldr: The latest economic data showed the Fed's preferred inflation gauge rose 3.3% from a year earlier, meeting expectations. Guests discussed the persistent risks of trade tariffs, the legacy of trade advocate Gary Hufbauer, and broader economic uncertainties.

key_points.point: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge, the core PCE price index, rose 3.3% from a year earlier.
key_points.why_it_matters: It is a primary measure watched by the Federal Reserve to gauge underlying inflation trends.

key_points.point: Personal income rose 0.7% and spending rose lower than expected.
key_points.why_it_matters: These figures show consumer health and demand trends across the economy.

key_points.point: Adam Posen (Peterson Institute) warns that trade tariffs act as a protectionist ratchet that stokes inflation and reduces competitiveness.
key_points.why_it_matters: Higher tariffs on countries like Canada could further strain trade policies and economic growth.

key_points.point: The podcast paid tribute to the late Gary Hufbauer, a prominent free trade advocate.
key_points.why_it_matters: His work shaped modern trade economics and the analysis of tariffs.

numbers.context: The year-over-year increase in the core PCE price index.

summary.lesson: When trade barriers and tariffs increase, they tend to drive up costs for downstream industries and consumers, acting as a structural driver of inflation.
opinions_and_predictions: Adam Posen (Peterson Institute) thinks tariffs are a protectionist ratchet that will maintain or worsen trade restrictions.
Adam Posen (Peterson Institute) believes the Trump administration's trade policies failed to achieve manufacturing growth and instead increased uncertainty.

glossary.definition: Personal Consumption Expenditures price index excluding food and energy, watched by the Fed as a key inflation measure.
glossary.example: The core PCE price index rose 3.3% from a year earlier.

glossary.definition: A tax imposed by a government on imported goods.
glossary.example: Proposed tariffs on Canada could raise costs for consumers.

glossary.definition: An economic policy designed to maximize exports and minimize imports for an economy.
glossary.example: A shift toward a neo-mercantilist policy framework.

summary.quality_note: The episode features substantive analysis from economists and experts discussing inflation data and trade policy, backed by economic figures.
